stories.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
stories.body: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.

stories.title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
stories.body: It is the latest case involving Nicolas Sarkozy who became the first French ex-president to go to jail last year.

stories.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
stories.body: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.

stories.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
stories.body: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

stories.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
stories.body: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.

stories.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
stories.body: The Emir of Daura is one of Nigeria's best-known monarchs, with politicians often trying to gain his support.

stories.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
stories.body: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.

stories.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
stories.body: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

stories.title: What Jensen Huang's return teaches China's Xi about Trump
stories.body: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

stories.title: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times
stories.body: Published extracts from the late pontiff's diary claim one of the visions happened "in the choir loft" during Mass.

stories.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
stories.body: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

stories.title: Zimbabwean convicted in South Africa of trying to fight in Ukraine
stories.body: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.

stories.title: Car bomb tears through Colombian city wounding more than 20
stories.body: The explosion is the latest in a string of attacks on buildings housing the security forces and government offices.

stories.title: DR Congo says military aircraft missing as rebels claim to shoot down plane
stories.body: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.

stories.title: Russian governor detained in rare criminal case against regional leader
stories.body: Andrei Chibis, head of Russia's northern Murmansk region, is the first governor to be detained for five years.

stories.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
stories.body: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

stories.title: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
stories.body: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.

stories.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
stories.body: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.

stories.title: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend Molly Meldrum
stories.body: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.

stories.title: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
stories.body: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops detained 'El Chapo Isidro', who had managed to evade capture for years.
